title: Coordination-Free Workload Regularization for Variable-Cost Distributed Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.21162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times o

translated_title: 面向可变成本分布式训练的无协调负载正则化
translated_abstract: 同步数据并行训练通常为每个rank分配相同数量的记录，即使记录的成本相差数个数量级。对于可变长度模型，这会将输入差异转化为空闲时间，因为每一步都必须等待本rank最昂贵的批次。我们提出了批次成本前瞻（Batch Cost Lookahead, BCL），这是一种无协调的数据加载策略，它缓冲一个有界的rank本地窗口，并将其重新分区为估计成本均衡的固定容量打包。BCL保留了训练器的记录数量契约，既不需要跨rank元数据交换，也不需要修改运行时。在基于公开工作负载分布的仿真中，启用BCL可将每个rank的估计批次成本变异性降低高达82.8%。在八块H200 GPU上对13个NeMo-RL SFT语料库的测试中，rank本地BCL比池化MFFD快1.050至1.167倍。在内部序列工作负载上的H200编译实测显示加速比达1.197至1.343倍。
tldr: 提出无协调数据加载策略BCL，通过均衡各rank批次的估计成本将批次成本变异性降低高达82.8%，在无需跨rank通信或运行时修改的情况下实现最高1.343倍的训练加速。
en_tdlr: Proposes BCL, a coordination-free data-loading policy that balances estimated batch costs across ranks, reducing batch-cost variability by up to 82.8% and achieving up to 1.343x training speedup without cross-rank communication or runtime modification.
